paper_title: Erratum: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity
notes: Corrected limits from erratum published June 2021. Measured exclusion zones for g_aγγ at 95% confidence level. Two discrete measured mass ranges: 7.44-19.38 neV with g_aγγ ≥ 3×10^-3 GeV^-1 (upconversion mode, UPLOAD-CMC-II-RT copper resonator at room temperature); 74.4-74.5 μeV with g_aγγ ≥ 10^-2 GeV^-1 (high frequency mode, UPLOAD-CMC-II-Cryo cryogenic implementation shown for reference). Measurement gap for intermediate masses (20-70 neV range) due to cavity tuning constraints. Integration time: 2.5 hours at nominal operating points. Sign error corrected in erratum relates to mode overlap coefficients; final coupling limits confirmed through Monte Carlo analysis with 95% rejection of false positives.
